recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. If the capability is still needed, follow up in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#646 and the tooling-extension source consumed by the publisher; do not add a core ImplementationGuide element unless FHIR-I reopens the decision.
issue_request: The Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requested a way for an IG to refer to profiles or pages in another IG without declaring a dependency and its conformance implications; the final resolution narrowed this to a tooling extension with no changes needed to the IG resource.
initial_application: No FHIR core commit or current source reference mentioning FHIR-38729, refersTo, or HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#646 was found. The active ImplementationGuide resource contains the earlier dependsOn.reason element from FHIR-36313 but no no-dependency relationship element.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes in October 2022, February 2023, and March 2023 show the progression from the non-dependency reference use case to an approved tooling-extension approach. The seed Zulip discussion identifies broken-link QA for narrative references as the practical problem, and Jira links the remaining work to the approved open IG Publisher issue HL7/fhir-ig-publisher#646.
reconciliation: An empty external-repo audit commit was published on the combined branch. No FHIR core source was changed because adding ImplementationGuide.refersTo or equivalent core content would contradict the final work-group decision.
